content: Single-instance guard for scripts that may be triggered both by an API and a scheduled task: portalocker.PidFileLock(...).fail_closed() is the purpose-built cross-platform pattern (uses msvcrt byte-range locking on Windows, fcntl on POSIX; exclusive locks auto-release when the process/fd dies, so no stale OS lock). Raw msvcrt.locking is error-prone (byte-range from current file position, needs fd, manual polling). Pre-4.2.0 portalocker had an LK_LOCK fallback-table bug; use current version. Advisory lockfiles only work if every contender honors them.
